payload.prompt:
Create a Europa Universalis V building Icon DDS asset.
Subject: A simple Europa Universalis V building icon in the uploaded vanilla Construction Center style, matching the companion Wonder Worksite icon's painterly language, compact crop, and low element count. Show a wonder material workshop with only three clear elements: a small workshop shed or lean-to, one stack of cut stone or timber material blocks, and one small workbench or anvil with restrained bronze accents. Sparse, centered, readable at 128px, premium but not ornate, no text.
Reference image: use the uploaded target-specific reference image only as style guidance for palette, brushwork, lighting, surface treatment, and framing discipline. Do not copy its subject, exact composition, silhouette, ornament placement, or any text.
Distinctiveness: keep the result in the same visual family as the reference, but make it visibly different at a glance through changed shape language, object arrangement, cropping, or decorative accents.
Composition: keep the main subject centered, readable, and high-contrast, with no watermark, no letters, no logo, and no UI chrome baked into the art.
Target format: final DDS target is exactly 128x128 and must stay under 100,000 bytes.
Target-specific requirement: This is a compact building icon for the Wonder Material Workshop (建材工坊), the sibling structure of the Wonder Worksite that processes raw goods into wonder building materials. Treat the uploaded Construction Center and Wonder Worksite references as the style authority: same simple painterly brushwork, compact crop, low object count, and readable 128px silhouette. Depict the workshop using exactly 2-3 simple shapes: one small workshop shed or lean-to, one stack of cut stone/timber material blocks, and one small workbench or anvil. The result should feel premium through restrained marble and bronze accents while staying as simple as the reference. Do not add extra props, workers, crowds, complex scaffolding, full scenery, a finished monument, a palace, or a narrative construction scene.
Style rules:
Match the palette, brush feel, lighting, icon density, and framing discipline of the selected target's reference image. Keep the final subject and asset meaning driven by the selected batch entry, not the reference subject.
Extra composition rules:
Use the reference only as a style guide. Keep the result in the same visual family, but make it visibly distinct at a glance by changing the silhouette, crop, object arrangement, and ornament placement. Do not mirror the reference composition or reuse its exact outline.
Avoid:
busy construction scene, many objects, extra props, many tools, crowds, workers, multiple buildings, complex scaffolding, ornate palace, completed monument, giant statue, landscape background, detailed narrative scene, realistic photo, text, letters, logo, UI frame
